test_shuffle_preserves_number_of_tests: test that shuffled test lists preserve the same number of tests as original lists
test_shuffle_changes_test_order: test that shuffling changes the order of all, active, filtered, and sharded test lists
test_shuffle_changes_test_case_order: test that shuffling changes the order of test cases extracted from test lists
test_shuffle_does_not_repeat_test: test that no test appears more than once in any shuffled test list
test_shuffle_does_not_interleave_test_ca: test that test cases are not interleaved and remain grouped together after shuffling
